name: kairo-engine
description: Modern, Modular, High-Performance 2D/3D TypeScript Game Engine & Web-Based Editor

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:package && mkdir -p dist/wasm && cp -r public/wasm/* dist/wasm/ && mkdir -p dist/examples/go-raylib-tester && cp -r examples/go-raylib-tester/*.wasm examples/go-raylib-tester/*.js dist/examples/go-raylib-tester/ && cp -r examples/go-wasm/*.wasm examples/go-wasm/*.js dist/examples/go-wasm/ && cp -r examples/go-runner/*.wasm examples/go-runner/*.js dist/examples/go-runner/
scripts.build:package: npm run build:lib && npm run build:types
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=8 tests/ai.test.js tests/ecs.test.js tests/math.test.js tests/physics.test.js tests/serializer.test.js tests/animation.test.js tests/particles.test.js tests/assets.test.js tests/compiler.test.js tests/recorder.test.js tests/fox-movement.test.js tests/network.test.js tests/plugins.test.js tests/events.test.js tests/geometry.test.js tests/cinematic.test.js tests/video-editor.test.js tests/shader.test.js tests/shared-context.test.js tests/serializer-encryption.test.js tests/bug-detector.test.js tests/cli.test.js tests/quests.test.js tests/dialogue.test.js tests/combat.test.js tests/tween.test.js tests/camera-fx.test.js tests/input.test.js tests/inventory.test.js tests/state-machine.test.js tests/ui-floating.test.js tests/combo.test.js
scripts.test:all: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=8 tests/ai.test.js tests/ecs.test.js tests/ecs-stress.test.js tests/soa-benchmark.test.js tests/math.test.js tests/physics.test.js tests/serializer.test.js tests/animation.test.js tests/particles.test.js tests/assets.test.js tests/compiler.test.js tests/recorder.test.js tests/fox-movement.test.js tests/network.test.js tests/plugins.test.js tests/events.test.js tests/geometry.test.js tests/cinematic.test.js tests/video-editor.test.js tests/shader.test.js tests/bug-detector.test.js tests/cli.test.js tests/quests.test.js tests/dialogue.test.js tests/combat.test.js tests/tween.test.js tests/camera-fx.test.js tests/input.test.js tests/inventory.test.js tests/state-machine.test.js tests/ui-floating.test.js tests/combo.test.js
